battle.name: 柬埔寨內戰
battle.brief: 柬埔寨內戰於1967年3月爆發，衝突發生於柬埔寨境內，柬埔寨共產黨游擊隊與政府軍及南越部隊相互對抗。戰事結合游擊行動與正規作戰，雙方使用步兵武器、機槍及野戰砲兵；線膛砲（Muzzle-loading field gun）為十九世紀中葉已列裝的野戰火炮。

kit.name: 線膛砲
kit.history: 線膛砲（Muzzle-loading field gun）在德軍早期野戰炮兵體系中配置於步兵師或炮兵單位，以中程火力支援步兵攻勢與防禦，並配合部隊機動作戰。

countries: 本文把1967年視為柬埔寨內戰公開成形的主要起點，追蹤至1975年4月17日。1967年的正式國家仍是柬埔寨王國，並非1970年政變後才出現的柬埔寨共和國。主要對抗組合是王國政府與皇家柬埔寨軍，以及柬埔寨共產黨的赤色高棉武裝、越南南方民族解放陣線與北越軍；美軍和南越軍在1967年至1973年直接介入最深，但各年執行的任務並不相同。美國自1964年起空襲柬境，1967年的Menu行動仍在執行，8月開始的Fresh Start行動則把重點放在東北部、西北部庇護區及胡志明小徑側翼的補給線。南越提供空軍、邊境部隊與後勤支援。中國向北越供應武器，並在1970年後支援柬埔寨共產黨；蘇聯主要支援北越。泰國容許美軍使用基地與機場，卻不是主要地面交戰方。直接作戰、空襲、武器供應與外交支持是四種不同角色，不能混成同一種介入。
countriesEn: This account treats 1967 as the principal starting point for the open phase of the Cambodian Civil War and follows it through 17 April 1975. In 1967 the formal state was still the Kingdom of Cambodia; the name Khmer Republic belongs to the post-coup period beginning in 1970. The principal opposing alignments were the royal government and Royal Cambodian Armed Forces on one side, and the Khmer Rouge armed forces of the Communist Party of Cambodia, the Viet Cong or National Liberation Front of South Vietnam, and North Vietnamese forces on the other. American and South Vietnamese involvement was deepest from 1967 through 1973, but their missions changed over time. The United States had been bombing Cambodia since 1964. Operation Menu continued during 1967, while Operation Fresh Start began in August and concentrated on sanctuaries in northeastern and northwestern Cambodia and on the lateral supply lines of the Ho Chi Minh Trail. South Vietnam supplied air support, border forces, and logistical assistance. China provided weapons to North Vietnam and supported the Cambodian communists after 1970, while the Soviet Union primarily assisted North Vietnam. Thailand allowed American use of bases and airfields but was not a principal ground belligerent. Direct combat, aerial attack, weapons supply, and diplomatic support were distinct forms of participation and should not be conflated.
people: 王國方面的核心人物是國王蘇拉瑪里、首相龍諾與參謀長英丹。龍諾於1967年5月5日出任首相，1970年3月18日發動軍事政變，1975年3月10日辭職；他在戰局順利時獲得軍方與西方支持，但王國軍對空襲造成的損失、地方指揮失靈及後勤不足始終缺乏有效答案。蘇拉瑪里在政變後保留君主形式，實際權力已集中於龍諾政府。西哈努克於1960年至1962年再度擔任首相，後來流亡，1967年往返北京與平壤，並接觸中國和北韓領導層；1970年政變後，他與赤色高棉組成親王國民族聯合政府，獲得共產黨方面的政治背書，1975年4月3日再任首相。赤色高棉方面，農查是中央委員會核心人物，蓋·桑蓬是早期軍事指揮者，波布特自1960年代起掌握中央政策與組織方向，塔莫長期參與東北戰區指揮。美國方面，尼克森與基辛格決定干預規模，威斯特摩蘭在1968年前後交棒給艾布拉姆斯，美國駐柬大使戴維·奧斯本則負責與王國政府保持外交聯絡。北越與南方解放陣線保有各自的指揮體系，並非赤色高棉武裝的附屬。
peopleEn: The central figures on the royal side were King Norodom Suramarit, Prime Minister Lon Nol, and Chief of the General Staff General In Tam. Lon Nol became prime minister on 5 May 1967, led the military coup of 18 March 1970, and resigned on 10 March 1975. Western and military backing strengthened his position when operations went well, but the royal government never developed effective answers to the damage caused by air attacks, local command failures, or logistical weakness. Suramarit retained the monarchical form after the coup, while real authority had passed to Lon Nol's government. Norodom Sihanouk had served again as prime minister from 1960 to 1962 before going into exile. During 1967 he moved between Beijing and Pyongyang and met Chinese and North Korean leaders. After the 1970 coup, he joined the Khmer Rouge in forming the Royal Government of the National Union of Kampuchea, giving the communist movement political backing. He was appointed prime minister again on 3 April 1975. On the Khmer Rouge side, Nuon Chea was a central member of the central committee, Khieu Samphon was an early military commander, Pol Pot directed central policy and organization from the 1960s, and Ta Mok participated extensively in operations in the northeast. In the United States, Richard Nixon and Henry Kissinger set the scale of intervention, William Westmoreland handed command to Creighton Abrams around 1968, and Ambassador David L. Osborn maintained diplomatic contact with the royal government. North Vietnamese and Viet Cong forces retained separate command structures rather than becoming subordinate to the Khmer Rouge.
kits: 可確認並確有使用者的1967年裝備包括：皇家柬埔寨軍使用M1加蘭德步槍、M1卡賓槍、湯姆森M1928A1 submachine gun、勃朗寧Hi-Power手槍、M113裝甲運兵車，以及DHC-3水獺運輸機；柬埔寨空軍則操作A-1E空中攻擊機和T-28A教練兼攻擊機。美國與南越軍裝備M16、M60通用機槍、M2重機槍、M67 40公厘迫擊砲、M252 81公厘迫擊砲、UH-1H直升機、AC-47A武裝直升機、F-4B戰鬥機、A-1E、B-52D轟炸機、C-130A與KC-135加油機。赤色高棉和北越方面使用中國Type 53衝鋒槍、AK-47、SKS步槍、DP-28輕機槍、Type 53 82公厘迫擊砲及RPG-7火箭筒。彈藥口徑也按武器區分，M16使用5.56×45毫米北約彈，M1使用.30-06，M60使用7.62×51毫米北約彈，Type 53衝鋒槍使用7.62×25毫米，AK-47與SKS使用7.62×39毫米，DP-28使用7.62×54毫米俄制彈。以上型號在1967年或更早已列入各軍序列；這是一份可核實的類型清單，不是對每個營、每個月的完整編裝表。
kitsEn: Equipment confirmed in use and listed by 1967 included the M1 Garand rifle, M1 carbine, Thompson M1928A1 submachine gun, Browning Hi-Power pistol, and M113 armored personnel carrier used by the Royal Cambodian Armed Forces. The Royal Cambodian Air Force operated the A-1E attack aircraft and T-28A trainer and attack aircraft. American and South Vietnamese forces used the M16, M60 general-purpose machine gun, M2 heavy machine gun, M67 40 mm mortar, M252 81 mm mortar, UH-1H helicopter, AC-47A gunship, F-4B fighter, A-1E, B-52D bomber, C-130A transport, and KC-135 tanker. Khmer Rouge and North Vietnamese forces used the Chinese Type 53 submachine gun, AK-47, SKS rifle, DP-28 light machine gun, Type 53 82 mm mortar, and RPG-7 rocket launcher. Ammunition was matched to the weapon rather than interchangeable: the M16 fired 5.56×45 mm NATO, the M1 used .30-06, the M60 used 7.62×51 mm NATO, the Type 53 submachine gun used 7.62×25 mm, the AK-47 and SKS used 7.62×39 mm, and the DP-28 used 7.62×54 mm Russian ammunition. Every model named above had entered service by 1967 or earlier. This is a verifiable list of types, not a complete inventory for every company or month.
tactics: 1967年至1969年，赤色高棉主力仍以分散營隊、突擊組和地方武裝為核心，依據東北山區與叢林宿營，襲擊國道哨站、公路車隊和偏僻兵站，並利用季風、道路泥濘與王國軍巡邏間隔轉移。地方武裝破壞交通，主力則保存武器與戰鬥人員，避免在固定陣地長期消耗。王國軍常沿國道12號、7號及其他主要公路推進，以M113、步兵分隊和工兵清除路障，再由F-4、A-1與AC-47提供近距支援；B-52則執行庇護區|area炸彈任務。這種方式能迫使游擊隊移動，卻難以長期占據被轟炸的村鎮。1970年政變後，赤色高棉逐步把游擊隊整編為營、旅及較大的地區部隊，統一使用迫擊砲、火箭筒、無線電與繳獲車輛，能配合攻擊城鎮、切斷公路和轉入固守。美國在南越邊境發動協同掃蕩，10月至11月的Fishhook行動曾進入柬埔寨東部清剿北越後勤區，但地面部隊撤出後，部分補給活動隨即恢復。1974年至1975年，赤色高棉改以固定陣地、縱深梯隊和攻城分隊作戰，先奪取班隆、斯努等外圍據點，再切斷通往金邊的公路，最後由炮兵、迫擊砲隊和步兵攻占交通線及外圍陣地。美軍停止轟炸後，王國軍缺少空中與補給支援，守軍雖有工事和道路卻難以維持縱深。
tacticsEn: From 1967 through 1969, the Khmer Rouge main force remained organized around dispersed companies, strike groups, and local units. It used camps in the northeastern hills and forest to attack checkpoints, road convoys, and isolated posts, while exploiting the monsoon, muddy roads, and gaps in royal patrols. Local formations disrupted transport, whereas the main force preserved weapons and fighting personnel and avoided prolonged occupation of fixed positions. Royal Cambodian forces commonly advanced along National Highway 12, Highway 7, and other principal roads, clearing obstacles with M113s, infantry platoons, and engineers, while F-4, A-1, and AC-47 aircraft provided close support and B-52s conducted area bombing against sanctuaries. This approach could force guerrillas to move but could not hold bomb-damaged settlements for long. After the 1970 coup, the Khmer Rouge gradually converted guerrilla bands into companies, regiments, and larger regional formations. Mortars, rocket launchers, radios, and captured vehicles were integrated into plans to attack towns, sever highways, and occupy defensive positions. Vietnamese border forces conducted coordinated sweeps, and the Fishhook operation from October to November 1970 entered eastern Cambodia to clear North Vietnamese logistical areas, but some supply activity resumed after the ground forces withdrew. In 1974 and 1975, the Khmer Rouge shifted to fixed positions, echeloned infantry formations, and siege detachments. They first took outlying centers such as Banlung and Snuol, cut roads leading to Phnom Penh, and then used artillery, mortar teams, and infantry to seize transport corridors and perimeter positions. After American bombing stopped, the royal army lost both air support and regular resupply and could hold prepared works but not maintain depth.
data: 可核對的時間線如下：1967年5月5日，龍諾出任首相；同年Menu行動持續，Fresh Start於8月加入，10月20日至23日基辛格訪問金邊並會見龍諾及美方外交官。1968年，駐越美軍指揮權由威斯特摩蘭移交艾布拉姆斯。1970年3月18日，龍諾與英丹發動政變；同年10月至11月，美軍與南越軍執行Fishhook行動，短暫進入柬埔寨東部。1973年1月27日，越南相關各方在巴黎簽署停火協議，但該協議沒有直接約束赤色高棉；美國對柬境的Freedom Deal空襲仍持續至同年8月中旬才正式停止，龍諾政府則繼續獲得美援。1974年1月赤色高棉奪取班隆，同年10月控制通往柬埔寨東部的斯努，切斷若干省際道路。1975年3月10日龍諾辭職，3月3日已先由朗博代理；4月3日西哈努克被任命為首相，4月9日返回金邊；4月12日至15日 Frequent Wind撤運美國及盟國人員；4月17日赤色高棉進入金邊，同一周馬德望與暹粒亦已失守。作戰地理可分成三層：金邊及西南部由王國軍控制，國道2、3、4、5號構成首都與省區間的主要動脈，國道12號及7號通往東北補給區；北越主要物資沿胡志明小徑經寮國與柬埔寨東部進入，赤色高棉在1970年後則利用以中國為起點、經寮國進入柬埔寨東部的西哈努克小徑。美國轟炸由泰國境內基地起飛的B-52，以及由南越基地起飛的F-4、A-1和直升機共同執行，KC-135負責空中加油。王國軍早期由西哈努克港輸入美援，再以M35二點五噸及M54五噸卡車沿公路運送；1970年後，金邊波琴洞機場與公路車隊成為主要補給方式。美軍停止轟炸後，王國軍仍可得到武器與顧問援助，但缺少足以扭轉地面局面的成軍部隊。各方作戰傷亡沒有口徑一致且可核對的總數，因此不列精確總數，也不把來源互異的單次戰鬥數字硬加在一起。
dataEn: The verifiable chronology is as follows. On 5 May 1967 Lon Nol became prime minister. Operation Menu continued that year, Operation Fresh Start was added in August, and Henry Kissinger visited Phnom Penh from 20 to 23 October to meet Lon Nol and members of the American diplomatic mission. In 1968 command of the American forces in Vietnam passed from William Westmoreland to Creighton Abrams. On 18 March 1970 Lon Nol and In Tam carried out the coup. From October to November that year, American and South Vietnamese forces conducted Operation Fishhook and temporarily entered eastern Cambodia. The principal Vietnam parties signed the Paris accords on 27 January 1973, but those accords did not directly bind the Khmer Rouge. American bombing under Operation Freedom Deal continued until the middle of August and then stopped, while aid to Lon Nol's government continued. The Khmer Rouge took Banlung in January 1974 and seized Snuol in October, cutting several interprovincial roads. Lon Nol resigned on 10 March 1975 after Long Boret had briefly served in an acting capacity. Sihanouk was appointed prime minister on 3 April and returned to Phnom Penh on 9 April. Operation Frequent Wind evacuated American and allied personnel from 12 to 15 April. The Khmer Rouge entered Phnom Penh on 17 April, after Battambang and Siem Reap had fallen earlier in the same week. The operational geography had three levels. The royal government held Phnom Penh and the southwest, with Highways 2, 3, 4, and 5 forming the main arteries between the capital and provincial centers, while Highways 12 and 7 led toward the northeastern supply region. Much North Vietnamese materiel moved through Laos and eastern Cambodia along the Ho Chi Minh Trail. After 1970, the Khmer Rouge also received Chinese supplies along the Sihanouk Trail, which passed through Laos into eastern Cambodia. American bombing employed B-52s from bases in Thailand and F-4s, A-1s, and helicopters operating from South Vietnam, with KC-135s providing aerial refueling. Before 1970 the royal government imported American aid through Sihanoukville and moved it on M35 two-and-a-half-ton and M54 five-ton trucks. After the coup, airlift at Pochentong and road convoys became the principal supply methods. Even after bombing stopped, weapons and advisory assistance continued, but not enough organized ground forces were provided to reverse the battlefield situation. The belligerents do not have a consistent, verifiable total for wartime casualties, so no exact aggregate is given and incompatible figures from individual engagements are not added together.
cause: 1967年公開內戰的成因不是單一事件，而是舊殖民衝突、冷戰代理戰與柬埔寨內部權力矛盾逐步交疊。1954年法國在印度支那的統治結束後，柬埔寨建立王國，國王西哈努克以君主制和對外自主立場壓縮左翼政治空間，王國政府則獲得美國援助並逐步排除共產黨勢力。同一時期，越南革命網路沿邊境延伸，把北越軍隊與南方解放陣線的後勤體系帶入柬埔寨東部；美國自1964年起以「追擊」名義空襲柬境，雖未派地面部隊進入，卻逐步把東北部和西北部山區變成雙方都能活動的庇護區。赤色高棉在1960年代形成集中領導和穩定遊擊隊，1967年又把武裝以人民解放軍名義系統化，使原本分散的邊境衝突變成可向省區擴張的內戰。龍諾政府有王國軍、機場與西方援助，卻缺少女兵、裝甲、重型火力與全國後勤網絡；道路、季風與中央指揮又限制快速增援。1970年3月18日政變則是全面戰爭的直接引爆點：西哈努克被推翻後，赤色高棉獲得推翻龍諾的目標，西哈努克也藉與赤色高棉結盟重新取得政治位置，北越則繼續利用柬埔寨東部後勤區。現有檔案不支持把這場政變直接說成由華盛頓策劃；美國事前並未授權，而且也沒有能力保證龍諾政府長期存活。
causeEn: The open civil war that developed in 1967 did not arise from a single event. It resulted from the overlap of the former colonial conflict, the Cold War proxy struggle, and internal contradictions in Cambodian power. After French rule in Indochina ended in 1954, Cambodia became a kingdom. King Norodom Sihanouk used the monarchy and a foreign policy of autonomy to reduce the political space of the left, while the royal government received American assistance and gradually excluded communist forces. At the same time, the Vietnamese revolutionary network extended across the frontier and brought parts of the North Vietnamese and Viet Cong logistical system into eastern Cambodia. From 1964 the United States bombed Cambodia under a pursuit rationale. Although it initially committed no large ground force, the strikes gradually turned the northeastern and northwestern hills into sanctuary areas usable by both sides. The Khmer Rouge developed centralized leadership and dependable guerrilla formations during the 1960s, and in 1967 organized its armed wing under the People's Liberation Army name, turning a dispersed border conflict into an insurgency capable of expanding into provincial areas. Lon Nol's government had the Royal Cambodian Armed Forces, airfields, and Western assistance, but lacked enough infantry, armor, heavy firepower, and a nationwide logistics network. Roads, seasonal rains, and central command constraints slowed reinforcement. The coup of 18 March 1970 was the direct trigger for full-scale war. After Sihanouk was removed, the Khmer Rouge acquired a concrete goal of defeating Lon Nol, while Sihanouk recovered a political position by allying with the Khmer Rouge. North Vietnamese forces continued to use the eastern Cambodian logistics area. Surviving records do not support describing the coup as a Washington-directed operation. The United States had not authorized it and lacked the ability to guarantee the survival of Lon Nol's government.
impact: 1967年至1975年的最大軍事影響，是赤色高棉由一支可在叢林中保存核心的游擊力量，轉變為能掌握師旅級指揮、炮兵火力、無線電通信和補給車隊的常規軍隊。王國軍每次沿公路掃蕩都會迫使敵方分散，但美軍空襲主要摧毀固定宿營、倉庫和道路設施，未能在赤色高棉重新集結時持續追蹤。1970年的Fishhook行動可以暫時清剿東部補給區，卻沒有建立持續佔領的地面秩序；1973年停止轟炸後，龍諾政府更難以與赤色高棉爭奪外圍據點。外交方面，1973年巴黎協議處理的是北越、南越、美國與寮國的戰爭安排，沒有解決柬埔寨的武裝衝突。赤色高棉藉與西哈努克組成聯合政府取得合法性和王國象徵，但隨後又把西哈努克排除於核心決策之外，使這項合作無法轉化為穩定政府。到1974年，赤色高棉已能奪取省城、切斷公路並包圍金邊外圍，王國軍則主要依賴空軍、美元援助及首都周邊工事維持。戰局也使北越在柬埔寨東部的後勤負擔與美國空襲風險長期並存，區域戰爭因而沒有隨越戰停火而真正結束。
impactEn: The principal military effect from 1967 through 1975 was the transformation of the Khmer Rouge from a guerrilla force capable of preserving a core in the forest into a conventional army exercising division- and brigade-level command, artillery, radio communications, and motorized logistics. Every royal sweep along the roads dispersed the enemy, but American bombing mainly destroyed fixed camps, warehouses, and transport facilities. It could not remain on the trail after Khmer Rouge forces regrouped. Operation Fishhook temporarily cleared eastern supply areas in 1970 without creating a lasting ground occupation. Once bombing stopped in 1973, Lon Nol's government found it even harder to contest outlying positions. Diplomatically, the 1973 Paris accords addressed the war in North and South Vietnam, Laos, and the United States without resolving the Cambodian armed conflict. The Khmer Rouge obtained legitimacy and a royal symbol through its coalition with Sihanouk, then later excluded him from the central decision-making apparatus, so the arrangement did not produce a stable government. By 1974 the Khmer Rouge could seize provincial capitals, cut highways, and enclose the outer approaches to Phnom Penh, while the royal army relied increasingly on air power, American funding, and fortifications around the capital. The war also kept North Vietnam's logistical burden and American air-strike exposure active in eastern Cambodia, so regional escalation did not end with the Vietnamese ceasefire.
result: 這場以1967年為主要起點的柬埔寨內戰，最終不是以談判收束，而是在王國軍主力瓦解後，於1975年4月17日以赤色高棉進入金邊告終。4月17日以前，通往首都的若干公路與外圍據點已失守，龍諾在國外，朗博留在金邊並代表殘余政府辦理交接，西哈努克則剛在4月9日返國。赤色高棉取得的不是一場預先選定日期才發動的正面攻城，而是趁王國軍指揮崩解、各省部隊斷裂及補給中斷時接管國家權力；Frequent Wind則在此前把美國及盟國作戰人員撤離柬埔寨。此後的直接外國作戰角色基本結束，赤色高棉接管國家行政與軍事機構，內戰的軍事階段至此結束。歷史上也有人把1950年代的武裝衝突視為更早的起點；本文採1967年至1975年的通常框架，1975年4月17日是完成金邊權力轉移的明確終點。作戰傷亡總數沒有來源一致、可重複核對的統計，各方戰報又分別計算不同類型與不同期間的損失，因此本文不提供未經確定的精確傷亡數字，也不把1975年以後的統治時期混作戰役過程。
resultEn: This account's Cambodian Civil War, beginning in its principal open phase in 1967, did not end through negotiation. It ended on 17 April 1975 when the Khmer Rouge entered Phnom Penh after the effective royal armed forces had disintegrated. Before 17 April, several roads to the capital and its outer positions had already been lost. Lon Nol was abroad, Long Boret remained in Phnom Penh and formally handled the transfer for the remaining government, and Sihanouk had returned only on 9 April. The Khmer Rouge did not achieve a set-piece frontal assault on a predetermined date; it took state power while the royal command structure had fragmented, provincial units had lost contact, and resupply had failed. Operation Frequent Wind had already removed American and allied combat personnel from Cambodia. The direct foreign combat role then largely ended, and the Khmer Rouge took over the national administrative and military apparatus, marking the military conclusion of the civil war. Some histories treat armed activity in the 1950s as an earlier beginning, but this account uses the conventional 1967–1975 frame, with 17 April 1975 as the clear endpoint of the transfer of power in Phnom Penh. No single verified total exists for wartime casualties because belligerent reports counted different categories over different periods. Uncertainly precise totals are therefore omitted, and the governing period after 1975 is not treated as part of the military campaign.
